description: Ground truth for the AetherGraph synthetic testbed. Every item here was planted deliberately by testbed/docker-compose.yml, testbed/nginx/html, testbed/setup_gitea.py, corpus/frozen.csv, or collectors/vapt_report.json. Because the environment is constructed, recall can be measured against this file without an external labelling effort. Recall measured this way says whether the pipeline recovers what was planted; it says nothing about performance on real infrastructure.

seeded_evidence.what: c.brown@corp-testbed.local in an HTML comment on the :80 landing page
corpus row matching c.brown@corp-testbed.local to CorpTest_Dump_2021
plaintext USER=admin credential pair in secret.txt behind the /backup listing
exposed .git/config naming user.email c.brown@corp-testbed.local and repo internal-tools
invalid AKIAEXAMPLE000000000 canary committed in config.py
anonymous FTP access, recorded as a manual finding
DVWA default login condition, recorded as a manual finding

expected_links.rationale: the credentials file is reachable through the discovered /backup listing, so the link is directly observed
the exposed git config records the persona's email address
the corpus row literally contains the harvested address
the finding's location ftp://127.0.0.1:21 names a port the scanner observed open
the finding's location http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php names a port the scanner observed open

forbidden_links.why: the canary is an AWS-shaped key, the seed repository has no remote, and nothing ties the secret to the Gitea service. Any edge here is fabricated.
forbidden_links.regression_of: run_secret_scan.py hardcoded svc-{ip}-3000 as the target of every repository secret

forbidden_links.why: the FTP container is provisioned with FTP_USER=test. No account exists for c.brown, so an account node for that user on port 21 describes nothing in the environment.
forbidden_links.regression_of: run_identity.py created account-{user}-ftp for every harvested email

notes: SEED-BACKUP-CREDS names no service in its content, so it must not produce an account link to any service. The absence of that link is correct behaviour, not a miss.
No tri-layer (active+identity+manual) path is expected to be derivable in this testbed. The two such paths reported in earlier results existed only because of the two forbidden links above.
